sections.heading: JUST THINKING
sections.text:
Elsa kiya aap bhi waise hi wait krengi mera jaise main krrha hun kiya hamesha sirf meri rhengi mere liye wait krengi mujhse payar krengi meri absent main bhi mujhe chahengi mujhe yaad rakhengi mujhe duao main Sirf mujhe mangengi Allah se kahengi k ya Allah mujhe bs hamza hi chahye aur koi nh ager woh mere liye behtar hai to bhi mujhe de de ager nh hai to mere liye wohi behtar banade? 🫠

Mujhe pata hai aap mujhse kitni muhabbat krti hain aur usse ziyada apni family se apne baba se bhaiyo se mamma se aur unke liye shyd mujhe chor bhi sakti hain main aik short time k liye aik character rha apki story main aur idk kab tak rhonga par umeed krta hun aap apna wada nibhayengi lekin apni family ka trust Rakh ker aur mujhe hamesha is baat ka regret rhega k meri waja se apne apni family ka trust loose kiya par believe me maine aisa kabhi nh chaha tha lekin hamare ya chah ne aur na chah ne se kuch nh huta wohi huta hai jo Allah chahta hai aur ab maine sab Allah par chordiya hai uske hawale krdiya hai aur abhi jo sabse ziyada mujhe baat preshan krrhi hai k aap kaisi hain theek hai? 🙃 Bs aapko Allah ki hifz o aman main chorta hun woh sabse bara nighiban aur hifazat krne wala hai main apko usi ki hifazat main chorta hun 

Main Janta hun hamari society hamara culture apki family apke bhai ki jaga main huta to shyd main bhi waisa hi krta par meri niyat hamesha pak thi apse muhabbat meri pak thi apse shadi krna Chahta tha par isme ghalti na meri hai na apki na apki family ki yeh theek hi nh tha shyd niyat achi ho Ya buri log ise ghlt hi kahenge ghlt hi samjhenge par main aur mera Allah hi janta hai mujhe mere haal ko mere dil ko aur sorry kehne se mana kiya tha par honestly i feel sorry for u and also wanted to say sorry to you your parents your brothers and all your family ager unhe yeh sab bura laga aur ofc laga huga aur abhi waqt sahii nh tha jab sahii waqt huga to in sha Allah main khud baat kronga apke bhai se papa se bs jab tak mera intezar krna meri payari gudiya 🫠❤️

sections.heading: Thoughts 💭
sections.text:
Soch soch ker itna dard huchuka hai lagta hai kabhi migraine na hujae tomur na hujae Allah na kre par aisa hi lagrha hai roz dimagh Alag Alag sawal puchta hai aur khud phir jawab bhi dhundne lagta hai aur samjh nh aata main kiya krun bs Allah k hawale chor diya wohi mere dimagh se yeh sawal nikalenge mujhe har sawal ka jawab dhundne ki zarort nh hai mai bs apna wada pora kronga jo maine kiya tha intezar krne ka maine wada to yeh bhi kiya tha main apni family ko Elsa k ghr lekar jaoga ager aisi koi situation hugi par maine us waqt yeh bhi kaha tha k ager yeh possible na hua to main wait kronga aur maine ab wohi krrha hun aur kronga hamesha par maine pehle wala bhi krna chaha ghr main bataya pehli dafa baba ne mujhe mara mujhe nh yaad k unhone life main kabhi mujhe mara ho aur uske baad phir samjhaya bhi sahii tha shyd k we don't know the situation right now aur situation na jante huye ager hamne kuch aisa kiya jo nh krna chahye tha aur ager tumne hamesha k liye use kho diya to? Aur yehi hai jo main nh chahta yahi mera sabse bara dar hai k main use kho na dun aur yeh dar to ab aur barh chuka hai par sach main mujhe Allah par bharosa hai aur mera dil kehta hai k Allah ham dono ko aik krdega in sha Allah
Iske ilawa subha mujhe call ayi hui thi aik unknown number se 1m pehle ki hi thi mujhe laga kahin Elsa ne hi na ki ho to Maine call back ki aage se aik larki hi boli k Asalam O Alaikum maine kaha walaikum Assalam mujhe nh yaad k maine Kon krke pucha tha ya nh par us larki ne kaha sir aap game khelte hain online maine kaha nh main nh khelta usne OkiEe keh ker call cut krdi mujhe uske Asalam O Alaikum aur OkiEe k Andaz se aur voice se laga k woh Elsa hi thi to maine apni confusion dor krne k liye dobara call ki tab bhi mujhe Elsa jaisi lagi par maine call cut krdi k ager elsa hugi to mujhse game ka kyun pochegi phir mere khyal ate rhe k kiya pata aisa ho waisa ho sochta rha k shyd family k sath ho isliye game ka name liya phir Maine adhe ghante baad dobara call ki aur pocha k aap Elsa ho usne kaha nh Maine kaha ap Karachi se ho kehti nh Islamabad se aur mujhe literally lag rha tha k woh Elsa hai Wohi naram awaz thi jo elsa ki and akhri main usne g keh ker call cut ki wohi halki si awaz main aur Elsa bhi g hi krti thi ziyada tar par maine usse 3 Baar puch chuka tha usne kaha nh hun ab main isse ziyada kiya hi krsakta tha 🤧
Khyr call cut krdi par mera mind abhi sawal k jawab dhundne main laga hua tha kuch kuch soch rha tha aur phir samjh aya k yeh kiya pata kabhi khtm nh huga aur honestly mujhe sabse ziyada iski fikar nh k meri usse baat nh hui ya woh ayegi ya nh balke yeh hai k woh theek hai k nh?
Aur isi liye maine abhi tak arsalan Bhai ko wapis msg ya call nh ki aur abhi thori der pehle main yahi soch rha tha k krni chahye ya nh pehle kaha krleta hun par phir khyal aya k maine keh to diya tha k "OkiEe Bhai jaise aap kahenge waisa krlunga" isse ziyada izzat se kiya keh sakta tha use jisne pichle din mujhe dhamki di thi aur ab 3 weeks hugaye ab msg ya call kiya to kiya pata unki family main thora normal hua ho aur mera msg ya call phir garam krde to is waja se main msg nh kronga ager bhai ka phir msg aata hai ya call khudse to main kronga qk main khud k sakoon se ziyada Elsa ki khyriyat chahta hun

sections.heading: Dua 🤲🏻
sections.text: Ya Allah maine sab aapke hawale kiya elsa Jahan bhi hai usko salamat rakhna uske ghr main sakoon rakhna ager mere msg se usko takleef hugi to mujhe rok lena aur ager uske haq main behtar hai to aap khud rasta bana dena main, main apni trf se khamosh hun ab aap dekh lena mujhe teri rehmat ka intezar hai is baat ka intezar hai k jab to meri arz sun ker elsa aur mujhe hamesha k liye aik krde aur aik dosre ka mehram banade Ameen sum ameen 💗
